messages:
Samir Khanna: Async standup — acct-health escalations (what I did / blockers / today)

Caro Lee: Thanks — quick recap format's great. Short updates below.

Samir Khanna: What I did: triaged BluePeak webhook failures (400+ errors last 6h), repro'd on staging; found relay returning intermittent 502s. Blockers: need prod proxy logs beyond 7d (can't see full upstream traces) and confirmation from sales on whether retry policy change is acceptable for renewal. Today: will run end-to-end test and prepare canary patch if logs show transient upstream timeouts.

Caro Lee: What I did: pushed a soft retry change to relay-service in staging to add idempotency key header. Can someone from prod infra simulate BluePeak payloads? :eyes:

Javier Ortega: I pulled the proxy logs — looks like upstream read timeouts at the load-balancer layer, not the app. Snippet:
```
[2026-03-16T22:14:03Z] 502 upstream read timeout for POST /v1/events from 10.4.2.11 -> 10.7.0.3
```
I'll prolong the LB timeout to 30s for the affected route while we investigate. No config change yet in prod; need approval.

Priya Menon: Blockers from CS side: BluePeak renewal in 12 days; they asked about SLA around webhook delivery. Sales (Nora) needs tokenized delivery success rate last 30d to share. Also adoption: one mid-market customer reported embedding drops after migration.

Nora Blake: I can extract high-level usage, but finance wants an anonymized sample export. @Samir Khanna, do you want raw success/failure counts or full request IDs?

Samir Khanna: Counts by status code + hourly time series is ideal for the renewal team. If we need request IDs we can provide a small sample. I'll prepare a short query. Example curl for replicated test payload I'm running now:
```
curl -X POST https://relay.internal/v1/events \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer test-token" \
  -H "X-Customer: bluepeak" \
  -d '{"event":"purchase","id":"test-123"}'
```

Caro Lee: Test ran, got a 502 once then a 200 on retry. Suggest we merge the retry header change and do a 10% canary. If LB timeout bump fixes it, follow with revert of retry heuristic.

Javier Ortega: I'll schedule the LB timeout bump for 02:00 UTC (low traffic) pending thumbs up. Need one eng approver.

Priya Menon: Action items: Samir to run query + attach counts for Nora; Caro to prepare PR for 10% canary; Javier to apply timeout bump at 02:00 UTC; Nora to draft renewal note with tentative SLA language. Blockers: none else from CS but we need eng response for the LB change.

eng-oncall-bot: Deploy window scheduled: 2026-03-17 02:00 UTC -> apply LB timeout bump. Reminder: add rollback plan in PR.

Samir Khanna: +1 on the window. I'll be available for the patch validation. If anyone sees >=5% error rate after bump, ping me and I'll open an incident.

Caro Lee: Will open PR now and add a canary plan. @Javier Ortega please post confirmation once LB change is live so I can proceed.

Javier Ortega: Will do. Posting confirmation here after change. :thumbsup:

Nora Blake: Thanks all — I'll wait for the counts to finalize the renewal note. If we get a clean 24h after the fix, I'll propose the SLA wording.

Samir Khanna: End — quick standup wrap. If anything urgent pops, ping #eng-oncall or DM me.
